title: AutoDisconnect-check
description: Automatically disconnect from servers upon detecting customizable keywords in chat messages, on-screen titles, or boss health bars
body:
AutoDisconnect - Smart Ejection Utility

AutoDisconnect is a must-have utility mod for players who need an extra layer of protection or automation. It monitors specific in-game events and automatically disconnects you from the server when triggers are met, helping you avoid unwanted situations or server-wide events.

🚀 Key Features
💬 Chat Monitoring: Scans incoming chat messages for your custom keywords.
📺 Title Detection: Automatically detects Large Titles displayed in the center of your screen.
🩺 Boss Bar Scrutiny: Monitors the names of active Boss Bars (like the Ender Dragon or custom server bosses).
🛡️ Trigger Cooldown: Built-in protection to prevent multiple rapid disconnections.
🌍 Localization: Full support for both English and Simplified Chinese.
⚙️ How to Configure

After installing, you can find the configuration menu via ModMenu.

Open the Mods list from the main menu.
Select AutoDisconnect and click the Settings icon.
Add your desired keywords under each category (Chat, Title, or Boss Bar).
Example keywords: [SYSTEM ALERT], Warning, You have been targeted, Server Restarting.
📦 Requirements
Fabric Loader (1.21.1)
Fabric API
Cloth Config API (Required for the settings menu)
ModMenu (Highly recommended to access settings)
